title: Add a Japanese Cockpit Status derived view
rawUserRequest: Japanese capability is mandatory because most adopter engineers use Japanese. Correct every issue found by the comprehensive Japanese assessment before documentation alignment or release, using a separate complete Work Item lifecycle for each issue.

declaredIntent.summary: Generate and validate a Japanese Cockpit Status view from exactly the same governance model as the canonical English view.

outOfScope: Changing the canonical recommendation, governance model, verification result, ownership count, or evidence derivation.
Machine-translating Contract, Summary, decision-driver, path, command, identifier, status, or arbitrary evidence values.
Persisting a second generated status file in every repository lifecycle transaction.
Fixing JA-PR-001, JA-LIFECYCLE-001, or JA-DOC-001 in this Work Item.
Starting documentation alignment, deprecated-assets cleanup, or release.

sources.reason: JA-STATUS-001 records that Cockpit Status has no Japanese derived view or executable parity evidence.
The generator currently emits English-only active and no-active Markdown.
The validator currently regenerates and compares only the canonical English representation.
The canonical English view is rendered from one structured recommendation and evidence model.
Japanese interpretation guidance exists but does not provide an executable Japanese output path.
WI-16 requires JA-STATUS-001 to complete after the Wizard corrective and before later Japanese findings.

riskAssessment.reason: A localized view can misstate governance facts or clear the release blocker without executable parity and freshness checks.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized correction of every Japanese assessment finding and continuous execution.

preReviewWarnings: Review that Japanese output is derived from the canonical model rather than independently interpreted.
Verify every backtick-delimited machine value remains byte-identical and in the same order.
Verify active, blocked, no-active, Preflight, ownership, evidence, and recovery sections remain structurally aligned.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The status generator accepts --language en|ja for active and no-active output and rejects unsupported values before writing output.
Japanese Markdown is transformed from the canonical English rendering produced from the same governance model, not from a second fact derivation.
Japanese headings, reviewer conclusion, action guidance, Preflight, ownership, evidence, Task Outcome, calibration, decision, backtrack, and next-action chrome are readable Japanese.

All backtick-delimited machine values, paths, commands, identifiers, recommendations, statuses, counts, and evidence strings remain byte-identical and in the same order across English and Japanese views.
A Make target generates the Japanese view under target/ and a paired validation target rejects stale or hand-edited Japanese output.
Executable tests cover active, blocked, no-active, Preflight/Human Decision, ownership, Task Outcome, calibration inventory, backtrack, and unsupported-language paths.
The Japanese assessor requires generator language support, paired validation, and named executable parity tests before JA-STATUS-001 can pass.
The machine JSON and derived Markdown assessment are regenerated; JA-STATUS-001 passes while JA-PR-001, JA-LIFECYCLE-001, and JA-DOC-001 remain blocking.
English and Japanese Status reader documentation describes the on-demand derived view and preserves the no-hand-edit and non-claim boundaries.
Full local finish/archive, one PR, Hosted CI, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch cleanup, and synchronized clean main complete before JA-PR-001 begins.
guidelines: Keep the canonical governance model and recommendation language-neutral and single-sourced.
Localize presentation chrome only; preserve every evidence-bearing value byte-for-byte.
Generate and validate Japanese output deterministically; stale or manually edited views fail closed.
Require executable active and no-active parity tests rather than keyword or documentation presence.
Record remaining Japanese blockers and do not claim general fluency or release readiness.

intent.problem: Japanese documentation explains Cockpit Status, but the executable generator and validator emit only English. Japanese reviewers therefore cannot obtain a validated Japanese view, and the current assessor could only report the capability missing.
constraints: Derive both language views from one canonical governance model and one canonical English rendering.
Preserve machine facts and arbitrary evidence strings byte-for-byte.
Do not add a second persistent lifecycle artifact that expands archive and installer ownership rules.
Make stale or manually changed Japanese output fail validation.
Leave unrelated Japanese blockers active and complete this lifecycle before the next corrective.
intent.rationale: An on-demand, validated Japanese projection under target/ gives reviewers usable Japanese chrome without duplicating repository truth or expanding every lifecycle transaction.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An active Work Item status contains recommendation, Preflight, ownership, evidence, Task Outcome, calibration inventory, decision drivers, and backtrack data.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Japanese view has readable Japanese chrome and the exact same ordered machine values as the English view.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add red-first full-section parity tests comparing headings and every backtick-delimited value.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: There is no active Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Japanese no-active view preserves task/state/change-count and fail-closed ownership guidance while rendering Japanese chrome.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Generate English and Japanese no-active outputs and assert structural and machine-value parity.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A generated Japanese view is stale or manually edited.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The paired Japanese status check fails with a content-mismatch diagnostic.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Mutate an isolated Japanese output and require deterministic regeneration comparison to reject it.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A caller requests an unsupported status language.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Generation and validation fail non-zero before writing or accepting output.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add CLI parser and output-preservation regressions for an unsupported language.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Japanese labels exist in documentation or source but no paired executable parity test/validator exists.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Strengthen the assessor to require generator, checker, Make targets, and named executable parity tests.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized all Japanese capability corrections before release and continuous execution.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
